# Cerulion Corporate Contributor License Agreement

This Corporate Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement") allows a company
or other legal entity (the **"Corporation"**) to authorize contributions to
Cerulion, a project of Cerulion Inc. ("Cerulion"), by the Corporation's
designated employees, and documents the rights the Corporation grants to
Cerulion in those contributions.

Like the [Individual CLA](individual.md), this is a **license grant, not a
copyright assignment**: the Corporation keeps full ownership of its work and
every right to use it for any other purpose. The grant lets Cerulion
distribute the project, including the Corporation's contributions, under
both its open-source license (AGPL-3.0-only) and separate commercial
licenses.

## How to execute this Agreement

Corporate signing is handled manually. Have an authorized representative
email a signed copy of this Agreement, together with the initial list of
designated employees (Schedule A), to
[licensing@cerulion.com](mailto:licensing@cerulion.com). Cerulion will
confirm receipt and record the covered GitHub usernames in the project's
signature store so the CLA bot recognizes them.

## 1. Definitions

**"Corporation"** means the legal entity executing this Agreement.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including source
code, documentation, configuration, schemas, tests, and benchmark code,
that is intentionally submitted to Cerulion by a designated employee of the
Corporation (Schedule A) for inclusion in, or documentation of, any project
owned or managed by Cerulion (the **"Work"**). "Submit" means any form of
communication sent to Cerulion or its representatives, including via pull
request, issue, or patch on the project's repositories, but excluding
communication conspicuously marked "Not a Contribution."

## 2. Grant of Copyright License

Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Corporation grants to Cerulion

The Corporation retains all right, title, and interest in its

to use, license, or distribute its own Contributions for any other purpose.

## 3. Grant of Patent License

Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Corporation grants to Cerulion

## 4. The Corporation's Representations

The Corporation represents that:

1. It is legally entitled to grant the above licenses.
2. Each employee designated on Schedule A is authorized to submit
   Contributions on behalf of the Corporation.
3. Each of the Corporation's Contributions is the Corporation's original
   creation, or the Contribution submission includes complete details of
   any third-party license or other restriction (including related patents
   and trademarks) of which the Corporation is aware and which is

## 5. Schedule A Maintenance

It is the Corporation's responsibility to keep its list of designated
employees current. Additions and removals are made by emailing
[licensing@cerulion.com](mailto:licensing@cerulion.com) from an authorized
representative. Contributions submitted by an employee before their removal
from Schedule A remain covered by this Agreement.

## 6. Support; Disclaimer

The Corporation is not expected to provide support for its Contributions,
except to the extent it desires to provide support. Unless required by
applicable law or agreed to in writing, the Corporation provides its
Contributions on an **"AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
KIND**, either express or implied, including, without limitation, any
warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, or
FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 7. Notification

The Corporation agrees to notify Cerulion of any facts or circumstances of
which it becomes aware that would make the representations in this
Agreement inaccurate in any respect.
